name: S-R6
description: S-R6, also known as Essar, was an assassin droid active during the Galactic Civil War. For each of his missions, he had his central programming and circuits transferred to a different droid shell for the purposes of disguise. S-R6 developed an enthusiasm for firearms, which affected his personality traits, and came to own a private collection of guns from throughout the galaxy. He also employed a protocol droid, T-3PO, as a valet and go-between.
